args.prompt: The creature is cute, silly and friendly, never scary, in the same chunky pixel style and outline as the cat-unicorn reference sheet. A cute PIXEL INVADER: a classic retro arcade space-invader alien built from chunky pink and cyan blocks with two big round shiny eyes, two tiny antennae and a wide smile. Draw exactly 8 frames in ONE horizontal row, equally spaced, every frame the same size and all on the same invisible ground line, plenty of empty space between frames so no frame touches another. Side view facing left. Frames: (1)-(4) hover animation with the little legs moving in and out; (5)-(6) charging pose with a glowing mouth; (7)-(8) dizzy and glitchy with spiral eyes and tiny stars. Each creature is about 16 percent of the image height. 16-bit Super Nintendo style pixel art, chunky hard square pixels, a clean 1-pixel dark plum outline, flat cel shading with one highlight and one shadow tone, light from the top left, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no text, no labels, no watermark. Solid flat cyan background, nothing else.
